Name: Fancy Sprinklers
Author: trashcan9
Description:
This mod adds an additional sprinkler type and adds some upgrades to vanilla sprinklers.

[size=5]Features[/size]
[list]
[*]Adds line sprinklers that are compatible with more mods and accept attachments.
[list]
[*]Inspired by the old [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2917]Line Sprinklers[/url] mod
[/list][*]Sprinklers are passable
[list]
[*]Can walk through sprinklers.
[*]Sprinklers can be placed on crop tiles.
[/list][*]Enables use of both sprinkler attachments simultaneously.
[*]Enricher attachment can apply multiple types of fertilizer when the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7436]MultiFertilizer[/url]﻿ mod is installed.
[list]
[*]This mod fixes a bug in MultiFertilizer mod in case you previously had problems with that mod working incorrectly.
[/list][*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url].
[list]
[*]Both MultiFertilizer and Tractor Mod function together with sprinkler enrichers.
[*]Fixes various fertilizer issues in Tractor Mod.
[/list][*]Sprinklers can water garden pots and pet bowl.
[*]Sprinklers run before sleeping so that there is no need to manually water tiles after placing sprinklers.
[*]Adds a very small number of sources of sprinkler attachments to be found earlier in the game (optional, requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url]).
[/list]

[size=5]
Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install requirements listed above under Requirements.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
[list]
[*]Recipes for the new sprinkler types will be learned with the appropriate Farmer skill.
[list]
[*]The basic/quality/iridium Line Sprinkler recipes will be learned at the same Farmer skill level as the basic/quality/iridium vanilla sprinkler recipes.
[*]In case you don't see the recipes, the recipes will probably be near the bottom of the recipe page, separate from the vanilla recipes.
[/list][*]To use multiple types of fertilizers in enrichers, install the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7436]MultiFertilizer[/url]﻿ mod
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. If there are issues, please report them.
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7661]Sprinkler Activation[/url] mod.
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1691]Data Layers[/url] mod.
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10931]Flexible Sprinklers[/url]﻿ mod.
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15239]Immersive Sprinklers[/url]﻿ mod.
[*]Compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url].
[*]This mod make enrichers and tractors compatible with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7436]MultiFertilizer[/url]﻿ mod.
[/list]

[size=5]Configuration[/size]
[list]
[*]Configuration options allow you to change the range of the line sprinklers. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to adjust config in game.
[*]By default, sprinklers are drawn slightly off-center of its tile so that it remains visible when a crop is planted on the same tile. This can be disabled or modified via the config. To disable, uncheck the "Enable Visual Options" setting via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] (or edit the config.json manually):
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2dSkuWX.png[/img][/list]

[size=5]Known Issues[/size]
[list]
[*][b]My Fancy Sprinkler icons are Weeds![/b]
[list]
[*]Due to issues in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets (DGA)[/url], in some menus (e.g. level up), the new items show up as Weed icons. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365?tab=posts&jump_to_comment=122198784]here[/url]﻿ for more details.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]DGA[/url]﻿ has some minor incompatibilities with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url]﻿. Icons will sometimes show up as a Weed icons (missing icon) in Lookup Anything, but this is only visual. See [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365?tab=posts&jump_to_comment=122098536]here[/url]﻿ for more details.
[/list][*][b]My Fancy Sprinkler recipes are missing![/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]DGA[/url]﻿ crafting recipes may not show up if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6293]Custom Crafting Stations[/url]﻿ installed. This issue between DGA and CCS can affect this mod.[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] fixes this issue, so as a work around, you can either install Better Crafting or uninstall CCS.
[/list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]DGA[/url]﻿ crafting recipes may not show up if the 'Craft from Chest Distance' feature/setting in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chests[/url]﻿ is set to a high value. Lower or disable that setting in Better Chests if the recipes are misbehaving.
[/list][/list]
